name: wick
title: Wick
description: Start, stop and check Wick, the menu bar app that keeps your Mac awake.
author: abulkosim

commands.name: wick
commands.title: Keep Awake
commands.subtitle: Wick
commands.description: See whether your Mac is kept awake and start or stop a session.

commands.name: toggle
commands.title: Toggle Keep Awake
commands.subtitle: Wick
commands.description: Start Wick's default session, or stop whatever keeps your Mac awake.

commands.name: start
commands.title: Keep Awake for
commands.subtitle: Wick
commands.description: Keep your Mac awake for a number of minutes, until a time, or until you stop it.

commands.name: stop
commands.title: Stop Keeping Awake
commands.subtitle: Wick
commands.description: End Wick's session so your Mac can sleep.
